PASS on the fake backend only by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). This package is model-authored and unreviewed: driver.lock.json authored_by is {"kind": "model", "model_id": "deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017", "run_id": "wC-064"} and reviewed_by stays null. No human reviewed or tested it, no hardware was attached, and no hardware run is claimed.

WHAT IT SERVES: the card's confirmed entry symbol furniture.env.furniture_gym:FurnitureGym (furniture/env/furniture_gym.py:11) as a GymnasiumDriver in simulated mode R0, for the registered IKEASawyer-v0 environment (furniture/env/__init__.py:32-43). The bridge accepts the legacy gym API: FurnitureGym.reset() returns the observation only and step(action) returns (observation, reward, done, info) (furniture_gym.py:52-65). The contract is derived from the fake environment's spaces: cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action} where action is the wrapper's Dict with one default Box of 8 values (Sawyer ik dof 3 + 3 + 1 + 1, furniture_sawyer.py:60-64) bounded -1 to 1 per element (furniture.py:294-310); cap.world.reset.v1 takes an optional seed; cap.world.seed.v1 takes a seed. The observation is the wrapper's Dict: object_ob with 21 = (3 + 4) * 3 values for the three swivel_chair_0700 bodies (furniture.py:230-237, XML:19-47) and robot_ob with 15 = 3 + 4 + 3 + 3 + 2 values (furniture_sawyer.py:44-48). The episode horizon is the default max_episode_steps of 2000 (config/furniture.py:164-168). The driver declares no Limit: the only action bound comes from the live action space, and the bridge's ticks and seed bounds are class schema, so no site-limits.example.json is needed.

WHY A FAKE: the clone needs Python 3.7, MuJoCo 2.0 and Unity 2018.4.23f1 (docs/installation.md:3-7) and setup.py:11-31 pulls gym, mujoco-py, numpy and Unity bindings; package code never imports the clone and nothing was installed. backends['fake'] is the package's pure-Python F0 stand-in (.fake:FakeFurnitureGym) with the same public methods as FurnitureGym (reset, step, close). The card's mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but that path was not run: a backend name not listed in backends (sim) would be served by gym.make('IKEASawyer-v0', unity=False) through GymnasiumDriver.open_native, and it needs the pinned upstream stack. The fake's eef/gripper motion, reward and info values are placeholders, not facts or limits.

SEED AND RESET: FurnitureGym.reset takes no seed (furniture_gym.py:52-57), so the bridge records cap.world.reset and cap.world.seed seeds but cannot apply them; determinism is declared seeded with seed_control none because the clone seeds its numpy RandomState only at construction (furniture.py:72, default 123 at config/furniture.py:324). The reset input schema is narrowed to the seed only, because FurnitureGym.reset takes furniture_id/background and no options; an options input is refused INPUT_INVALID. The fake repeats exactly from a fixed placeholder start.

NOT COVERED: the MuJoCo furniture-assembly model itself (rigid-body dynamics, contacts, weld/equality constraints, inverse kinematics, gripper, furniture placement, the success predicate and the reward), all camera/depth/segmentation arrays (visual_ob defaults to False), the other agents and control types and their action sizes, the UnityInterface path and any rendering, and any trajectory comparison with the upstream environment. The fake returns the real low-dimensional lengths (object_ob 21, robot_ob 15) with placeholder values. Snapshot/restore is false: FurnitureGym exposes get_env_state but no get_state/set_state pair for the bridge. timestep_ms is the 100 ms control period (control_freq 10, config/furniture.py:72 and furniture.py:2855); the MuJoCo physics timestep is not stated in the clone (base.xml:4), so only the control period is published.

WARNINGS (none failed): G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer/numeric inputs the bridge derives (ticks, action.default[*] and seed twice); PLAYBOOK.md section 8 calls these expected for Gymnasium drivers. There were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue_requests and no x-cap ids.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps the check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds nine cases (reset/step reach the fake with the real observation lengths, the action space and length are enforced before the fake, a step moves the placeholder robot state, the 2000-step horizon ends the episode, the seed is recorded but does not reseed, reset options are refused, the fidelity contract is published, and the e-stop latches the simulation); G9 passed. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
